title: Weak-$L^\alpha$ Noise, Strong Guarantees: Gradient Clipping under Affine Heavy Tails
abstract: arXiv:2610.28107v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gradient clipping is a key tool for obtaining high-probability convergence guarantees for stochastic first-order methods under heavy-tailed noise. Existing analyses typically assume a bounded central moment of order $\alpha\in(1,2]$, which excludes distributions with tails of order $u^{-\alpha}$ at the critical exponent. In this paper, we consider smooth convex optimization under affine heavy-tailed noise, whose scale may grow with the gradient norm. We derive high-probability convergence guarantees for clipped SGD (Clip-SGD) and its accelerated variant Clip-SSTM under a weak-$L^\alpha$ tail condition, which is strictly weaker than the corresponding moment bound. For $1<\alpha<2$, the clipping bounds have the same powers of the clipping level as in the moment case, and both methods attain the additive stochastic rate $K^{-(\alpha-1)/\alpha}$. The gradient-dependent noise contributes a faster-decaying term of order $K^{-2(\alpha-1)/\alp

translated_title: 弱-$L^\alpha$ 噪声，强保证：仿射重尾条件下的梯度裁剪
translated_abstract: 梯度裁剪是在重尾噪声下为随机一阶方法获得高概率收敛保证的关键工具。现有分析通常假设 $\alpha\in(1,2]$ 阶中心矩有界，这排除了在临界指数处尾部阶为 $u^{-\alpha}$ 的分布。本文考虑仿射重尾噪声下的光滑凸优化问题，其中噪声尺度可能随梯度范数增长。在弱-$L^\alpha$ 尾部条件（严格弱于相应的矩条件）下，我们为裁剪随机梯度下降法（Clip-SGD）及其加速变体 Clip-SSTM 推导了高概率收敛保证。当 $1<\alpha<2$ 时，裁剪界中裁剪水平的幂次与矩条件情形相同，且两种方法均达到可加随机率 $K^{-(\alpha-1)/\alpha}$。梯度相关噪声贡献了一个衰减更快的项，其阶为 $K^{-2(\alpha-1)/\alpha}$。
tldr: 本文在严格弱于矩有界假设的弱-$L^\alpha$ 重尾条件下，为仿射重尾噪声驱动光滑凸优化中的裁剪SGD及其加速变体建立了高概率收敛保证，并达到与矩条件情形相同的随机收敛率。
